verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs say that connecting GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket deploys on every push with a preview URL for every branch, giving automatic preview environments for testing changes before production. Supporting docs cover commenting on and access-protecting those preview URLs. missing for 10: explicit documentation tying preview URLs to pull requests (e.g., the URL posted on the PR) rather than to branches/pushes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
Let teams and invited collaborators comment on your preview and production environments.
Control who can open your preview and production URLs with Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs.
